study_identification_part.si_4_title: Developmental trajectories of neuroanatomical alterations associated with the 16p11.2 Copy Number Variations

nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: Mixed-effects model (using nlme package) with fixed effects for age (linear and quadratic) and sex, and random effects for intercept and age slope.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: The mixed-effects model that best fits the normative data is: Vol i = β 0 + γ 0 + ( β 1 + γ 1) (Age i -13) + β 2 (Age i -13) 2 + β 3 Sex i + ε i ... The mixed-effect models were built using the nlme package.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.location: CardenasDeLaParra2019.pdf.md: 2.4.1. Z-scoring for the main effect of age and gender for global and voxelbased volumes

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: Total intracranial volume, global gray and white matter volumes, regional volumes (lobes, thalamus, putamen, caudate, globus pallidus), ventricular volumes, and voxel-wise Jacobian determinants (Tensor Based Morphometry).
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: Results show that the total intracranial volumes, the global gray and white matter volumes ... Whole-brain, individual lobes, thalamus, putamen, caudate, globus pallidus and ventricular volumes were calculated ... Jacobian determinant of the deformation field was computed for every voxel ... and used as a surrogate metric of relative local tissue volume.

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: The normative model (mixed-effects) included fixed effects for Age (centered at 13), Age^2, and Sex, and random effects (intercept and age slope) for subjects.
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.supporting_text: The mixed-effects model that best fits the normative data is: Vol i = β 0 + γ 0 + ( β 1 + γ 1) (Age i -13) + β 2 (Age i -13) 2 + β 3 Sex i + ε i ... Age i , Age 2 i, Sex i are the fixed and random effect explanatory variables for subject i ... γ 1 is a random effect coefficient
